mechanism: Atazanavir (CYP3A4 inhibitor) increases albendazole metabolism and active metabolite (albendazole sulfoxide) exposure, while albendazole may induce CYP3A4, potentially reducing atazanavir levels.
action: Monitor anthelmintic efficacy and HIV viral load; consider alternative antihelmintic (ivermectin) or adjust atazanavir dosing if concurrent use is necessary; separate administration timing if possible.
